_what: unit mcap · the capability map read by ci/witness/mcap/witness_capability.mjs. Every id is validated by the witness against its owner at run time: a check id must be a key of CHECKS (scripts/teaching_gate.mjs) and an audit id an entry of CHECKED_RULES (scripts/teaching_audit.mjs), each named inside that organ's own selftest; a verdict must be one of its type's verdicts in VERDICT_TYPES (scripts/gaffer_brain.mjs). An id that fails any of these makes the clause UNREAD (exit 2), never green.
